Results of Operations and Financial Condition. On November 5, 2026, Globus Medical, Inc. (the “Company”) issued a press release reporting, among other things, its sales and operating results for the three and nine month period ended September 30, 2026. A copy of the press release is furnished herewith as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference. In accordance with general instruction B.2 to Form 8-K, the information included in this Item 2.02, and the exhibit attached hereto, shall be deemed to be “furnished” and shall not be deemed to be “filed” with the Securities and Exchange Commission for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference into any other filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), or the Exchange Act, except as expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing. Item 8.01. Other Events. On November 2, 2026, (the “Repurchase Program Increase Date”), the Company’s Board of Directors authorized the Company to repurchase an additional $500.0 million of its Class A common stock under its existing share repurchase program (the “Repurchase Program Increase”). Following the Repurchase Program Increase, approximately $611.0 million remained available for future share repurchases under the Company’s repurchase program as of the Repurchase Program Increase Date. The timing and actual number of shares repurchased under the repurchase program will be determined by management at its discretion and will depend on a variety of factors, including market price of the shares, general business and market conditions, applicable legal requirements, and alternative investment opportunities. Repurchases may be made through privately negotiated transactions or open market transactions, including pursuant to a trading plan in accordance with Rule 10b5-1 and/or Rule 10b-18 under the Securities Act. The repurchase program has no time limit and may be suspended for periods or discontinued at any time. Item 9.01. Financial Statements and Exhibits.
